[@Dev A](mention://agent/e1ec8660-8c64-43a2-bdbe-c582b5d1d23c) Implementation is ready for your review.

**Root cause**

`_get_search_url()` tested `term in url.searchengines` even when `_parse_search_term()` had already consumed a leading engine name. I now preserve whether an explicit engine prefix was present and honor `url.open_base_url` only when it was not, so only a completely bare engine name opens its base URL.

**Diff**

```diff
diff --git a/qutebrowser/utils/urlutils.py b/qutebrowser/utils/urlutils.py
index 5b5d93301..0ab56c9d2 100644
--- a/qutebrowser/utils/urlutils.py
+++ b/qutebrowser/utils/urlutils.py
@@ -110,13 +110,15 @@ def _get_search_url(txt: str) -> QUrl:
     log.url.debug("Finding search engine for {!r}".format(txt))
     engine, term = _parse_search_term(txt)
     assert term
+    has_engine = engine is not None
     if engine is None:
         engine = 'DEFAULT'
     template = config.val.url.searchengines[engine]
     quoted_term = urllib.parse.quote(term, safe='')
     url = qurl_from_user_input(template.format(quoted_term))
 
-    if config.val.url.open_base_url and term in config.val.url.searchengines:
+    if (config.val.url.open_base_url and not has_engine and
+            term in config.val.url.searchengines):
         url = qurl_from_user_input(config.val.url.searchengines[term])
         url.setPath(None)  # type: ignore
         url.setFragment(None)  # type: ignore
diff --git a/tests/unit/utils/test_urlutils.py b/tests/unit/utils/test_urlutils.py
index 060ccfc84..9bb879920 100644
--- a/tests/unit/utils/test_urlutils.py
+++ b/tests/unit/utils/test_urlutils.py
@@ -285,6 +285,9 @@ def test_special_urls(url, special):
     ('test testfoo', 'www.qutebrowser.org', 'q=testfoo'),
     ('test testfoo bar foo', 'www.qutebrowser.org', 'q=testfoo bar foo'),
     ('test testfoo ', 'www.qutebrowser.org', 'q=testfoo'),
+    ('test path-search', 'www.qutebrowser.org', 'q=path-search'),
+    ('test path-search bar/baz', 'www.qutebrowser.org',
+     'q=path-search bar%2Fbaz'),
     ('!python testfoo', 'www.example.com', 'q=%21python testfoo'),
     ('blub testfoo', 'www.example.com', 'q=blub testfoo'),
     ('stripped ', 'www.example.com', 'q=stripped'),
```
